models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

briefing.headline: Nine days out: pattern is light and benign now, but the trip dates themselves are well beyond any forecast.
briefing.synopsis: No forecast reaches the trip dates - the models run out at 30 Sep 23:00, and we depart 3 Oct. What we have now over the Aeolians is a slack, low-gradient regime: winds mostly 1-9 kt with no settled direction, swinging from NE through S to W and back within a single day. The one organised feature is a modest northerly filling in from late 25 Sep - Panarea 9.4 kt from N and Filicudi 8.9 kt from NNE at 18:00 on 26 Sep (ECMWF IFS 0.25°, 23 Sep 18Z / AIFS, 24 Sep 00Z / ICON-2i, 24 Sep 00Z consensus). Seas are flat throughout: 0.3-1.4 ft total wave, swell 0.1-1.5 ft, the largest being Filicudi at 1.7 ft wave / 1.5 ft swell late on 26 Sep.
briefing.overnight_anchorage: No trip berth applies yet. In the rehearsal run, tonight (24 Sep) is Portorosa Marina - enclosed, all-round shelter, and the choice does not matter in this air (2.4 kt, 0.3 ft wave at 18:00). The only rehearsal berth scored below sheltered is Marina del Gabbiano at Stromboli (workable, open from every direction) and San Pietro at Panarea on 26 Sep, where a 12 kt NE would blow straight in - Drautto is the recommended alternative there. Treat all of that as a check on the method, not as guidance for October.
briefing.tomorrow_morning: For the real trip, the 3 Oct arrival and 4 Oct first leg are nine days out and I have no model data for them - do not plan around anything in this brief. In the current live window, mornings are the quiet part of the day: Lipari 2.4 kt at 06:00 on 24 Sep, and the rehearsal scheduler picks 06:00 departures on every leg, with only Portorosa-Lipari showing deterioration after 11:00. If this quiet early-autumn pattern were still in place in October, it would mean motoring more than sailing and unrestricted berth choice - but that is a pattern statement, not a forecast.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsal go: 7.7 kt broad reach, 06:00 start, deteriorating after 11:00. Not a forecast for 4 Oct.
Rehearsal go: 8.7 kt head to wind - motoring leg as modelled.

passage_notes.note: Rehearsal go: 11.5 kt on the nose, motor. The breeziest leg in the set.

passage_notes.leg: Stromboli → Panarea, optional return (rehearsed 28 Sep for 6 Oct)
passage_notes.note: Rehearsal go: 3.1 kt broad reach - effectively calm.
Rehearsal go: 3.0 kt beam reach, gusts to 9 kt flagged but not treated as a caution in light air.
Rehearsal go: 5.2 kt broad reach, sheltered at Santa Marina or Rinella.

cautions: Nothing in this payload covers 3-8 Oct. Every verdict above is a dry run against late-September weather and carries no information about the trip dates.
Two points in the live window show real model spread: Stromboli 25 Sep 18:00 ranges 1.0-8.4 kt across models, and Salina 25 Sep 12:00 ranges 6.0-12.1 kt. Quote the range, not a mean.

Gust figures in light air are inflated: ECMWF IFS publishes an interval-maximum gust, which is why Lipari shows 42.4 kt against an 8.3 kt mean at 25 Sep 12:00 and Salina 37.1 kt against 8.4 kt. Do not read those as squalls.
Wind direction is the unstable element in this pattern - mean direction shift between runs is 43-63 deg at every lead time, even 0-12 h. Anchorage choice by aspect deserves a fresh look each evening.
briefing.confidence_note: IFS, AIFS and ICON-2i agree closely on wind speed inside the live window (mean run-to-run shift 0.6-1.5 kt out to 120 h) but disagree persistently on direction, and none of them reach the trip dates at all.

verification.measures: forecast stability, not verified accuracy - the reference is the newest model run for the same hour, not an observation
